## Board of Directors - Minutes Q3 2025

Strictly confidential

## 1. Attendance and quorum

Meeting held on 21 October 2025 at Tampere Works, Finland. Present: Maria Peltoniemi, Margareta Lindqvist (Chair), Henrik Aalto, Dr. Ines Carvalho, Pieter van Dam, Valdemar Peltonen. Also in attendance: Ilari Pesonen (COO) and Anne Laakkonen (General Counsel, secretary to the board). Quorum was confirmed.

The minutes of the previous meeting were approved without amendment.

## 2. Financial performance

The CFO reported Q3 FY2025 revenue of EUR 102.7 million against a budget of EUR 103.6 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.1% and cash of EUR 50.6 million.

Order intake for the quarter was EUR 109.6 million, giving a book-to-bill ratio of 1.07.

| KPI | Q3 FY2025 | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | EUR 102.7m | EUR 103.6m |
| EBITDA margin | 15.1% | 14.5% |
| LTIFR | 0.75 | 0.70 |
| On-time delivery | 92.6% | 93.0% |

## 3. Resolutions

The Board approved a share buy-back programme of up to EUR 13.5m.

The Board approved the appointment of Nordic Assurance Services as external quality auditor for a further three years.

The next meeting is scheduled for 20 January 2026.
